name: Mud cracks 8: city streets
description: The layer shrinks along each district's street direction first and across it later, so long parallel streets come first and cross streets follow at right angles, ending in T-junctions; as the city grows, blocks keep dividing into smaller blocks and lanes, and the oldest streets widen most. Paint district to turn a neighbourhood's grid, cross_lag for how long the first streets run alone, grow, dry, grip or toughness.
